actors: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
key_facts: The Consumer Price Index for October is due on Tuesday; economists broadly expect overall CPI to rise 0.3% m/m after a 0.6% jump in September, and core CPI to rise 0.2% m/m.

The BLS will not publish a year-over-year CPI comparison for October because data could not be collected during the government shutdown from Oct. 1 to Nov. 12 of last year; NYT will estimate the 12-month change using the geometric mean of September and November price levels.
